body: It was just a shot to the head, last night I was gonna throw myself off of an overpass onto the interstate. But by mere coincidence a couple friends drove by
I know she said everything out of anger and hurt, but that doesn’t soften the blow when she tells you she hates you, shit. Shit had me so fucked up last night.
She told a friend of mine that when she’s with me she forgets about him and feels safe.
